findings.codeql_raw_query:
import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization in SQLAlchemy
 * @description Detects unsafe deserialization operations that could lead to code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity critical
 * @id cwe-502
 */

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // Pickle deserialization
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    // Marshal deserialization  
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    // Yaml deserialization
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
    // Shelve deserialization
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe deserialization operations that could lead to arbitrary code execution

findings.codeql_raw_query:
import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

/**
 * @name Code execution via eval/exec
 * @description Detects dangerous eval() or exec() calls that could lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity critical
 * @id cwe-94
 */

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // eval() calls
    call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
    // exec() calls  
    call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
    // compile() with exec mode
    call = API::builtin("compile").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe code execution via eval/exec/compile that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Potential code injection via eval/exec/compile functions
